description: Safe local metadata pack for deterministic REST/OpenAPI evaluation and benchmark smoke tests.
safety_notes: The benchmark config defaults to dry_run true.
Attack and mutation execution are disabled by default.
The recommended base URL is a local placeholder, not an external target.
limitations: This pack does not include a runnable vulnerable application.
Ground truth describes mock behavior used by deterministic tests and thesis export examples.
Manual review is still required before using results as thesis evidence.
